residual_risks: checkProvidersDefined now computes bitbucketAPITokenDefined() before the map loop, so with both BitBucket credential sets present the count is deterministically 1 (old code: 1 or 2 depending on random map iteration order). Only count==0 is consumed, so no observable change; it removes a latent nondeterminism.

displayBitBucketStartupConfig compare check moved from strings.ToLower(x)=="refs" to strings.EqualFold(x, "refs"); differs only for exotic Unicode fold characters (e.g. long s), not a practical concern.
testing_gaps: No unit test pins the startup-config log output (displayStartupConfig helpers) or the Run() error-message/ordering sequence after decomposition; equivalence was verified only by reading old vs new code. Live provider tests skip offline.
